summary: The fresh stage chain passes the full frontend. Decimal calls execute correctly. The Rust producer now exposes checked intrinsic aliases; the next full build verifies the requested bundle and conditional-method linkage.
activity: The complete 18-program intrinsic consumer suite, all Rust test-target compile checks, and 35 tooling checks pass. Two workers are checking the remaining 197 Native target gates while Stage 2 and conditional linkage run separately.

blockers.title: Finish runtime dependency linkage
blockers.detail: The previous producer rejected a public intrinsic alias. Its repair passes focused ABI5/ABI6 checks. The next build also links conditional implementations through their checked declaring instance and method slot.
blockers.technical: The earlier full run requested 29 function and 4 dictionary roots. Two decimal intrinsics now pass executed tests. Candidate 17 is verifying the updated producer and consumer; no full bootstrap result yet.

blockers.title: Finish the bootstrap verification

blockers.technical: No Stage 2 IR or executable was produced by candidate 11. No fixed-point claim.
